examples.en: She wore a floral wraparound over her swimsuit.
examples.vi: Cô ấy mặc một chiếc váy quấn hoa bên ngoài bộ đồ bơi.

senses.definition: A computer feature that automatically moves text onto the next line when a line is full.

examples.en: Turn on wraparound so your sentences do not run off the screen.
examples.vi: Bật tính năng tự xuống dòng để các câu của bạn không bị tràn ra ngoài màn hình.

senses.vi: tính năng tự xuống dòng; tự ngắt dòng

senses.definition: A printed band, label, or jacket that wraps around a product or book.

examples.en: The novel came with a promotional wraparound recommending it to readers.
examples.vi: Cuốn tiểu thuyết đi kèm với một đai bọc quảng bá giới thiệu đến độc giả.

senses.vi: dải bọc; đai bọc sách; nhãn bọc

thesaurus.definition: a garment (as a dress or coat) with a full length opening; adjusts to the body by wrapping around

wiktionary.gloss: A garment that is wrapped around the body and tied.
A label or advertising display that wraps around a container.
A segment where material featuring one person (such as a reporter) is introduced and concluded by another person.
An extension to a property that combines side and rear additions.
Synonym of wraparound mortgage.

examples: See also: autowrap, backwrap, line break, word wrap, and wrapping
wiktionary.gloss: Word wrap, the word processing feature that moves text to the beginning of the next line if it will not fit at the end of the current line.

examples: The addition of integers is unchecked, so wraparound occurs if the resulting value is beyond the representable range.
wiktionary.gloss: The wrapping of numerical values in case of underflow or overflow.
An attempt to score by reaching around the side of the net from behind.
